decision: NX-028 D1/D2 (owner 2026-10-10, all as recommended): the owner workbench is its own browser business application; enterprise members are existing browser Humans written by trusted configuration only (no self-registration); a customer principal never holds a workbench grant. A role is a set of Action grants, compiled per member by nexloop_eios.workbench_roles and applied through trusted configuration (0050); the member list is private deployment data and never part of this file. Releasing a contact restriction (ADR-023 §2.4), cancelling a commitment, marking a communication commitment and goals/metrics/budget/pause stay owner-only. Actions marked slice 2/3 are declared by those slices; holding a grant before the Action is published grants nothing. v2: slice 3 Action names as published by L4 (nexloop.conversation.takeover/handback, nexloop.message.staff_send), owner and operator. v3 (NX-027, registry 0140): nexloop.commitment.bind_commercial for owner and operator — like attest and condition_met it supplies fulfilment grounds for a commitment, and it cannot fabricate evidence (only verified signed events of the bound reference count, and only for the commitment's own Consumer); nexloop.cost.record owner only — entered costs feed cost metrics and key results, which like goals, metrics and budgets stay with the owner.
